items.name: Key upstream production-capacity projects, 2025 operating results release
items.claim: PetroChina reported that it efficiently advanced the construction of key production capacity projects including Tarim Fuman and Sichuan Tianfu tight gas, and completed construction of two national-level shale oil demonstration zones in Jimsar and Daqing Gulong as well as the Qingcheng production base.
